parts.title: Structured prompting
parts.outcome: I tell the AI clearly what I need, so it guesses less and gives steadier answers.

ui.map_aria: Course map. You are at Part {n} of {total}.
ui.finished_body: Your work is saved in your project folder: your two prompts, their answers and the prompt you rewrote from your own work. You can now explain why giving the AI a structure gets better results, and you can use a framework or build your own. In Part 2 you turn "that looks good" into clear pass or fail rules. Reviews will still appear here when they are due.

parts.title: Defining evaluation criteria
parts.outcome: I turn "that looks good" into clear pass or fail rules.

ui.map_aria: Course map. You are at Part {n} of {total}.
ui.finished_body: Your work is saved in your project folder: your worksheet and your test cases in part-2\test-cases.md. You can now turn what you need from an answer into distinct criteria, give each one a pass or fail threshold a script could decide, and record them as test cases. In Part 3 an AI agent turns a file like this into a checker and runs it on real answers. The Northwind update is practice only and is not something to submit. Reviews will still appear here when they are due.

parts.title: Running evals and baseline
parts.outcome: I check five AI answers against my rules and record a starting score.

parts.title: Iterating with evaluation-driven development
parts.outcome: I change my prompt, check again with the same rules and see whether the score moved.

parts.title: Load-bearing audit and packaging
parts.outcome: I keep only the instructions that earn their place and package my work so someone else can use it.

parts.title: Your own task
parts.outcome: A live working meeting. You choose a task of your own that repeats, has clear requirements and can be checked by rules, and talk your ideas through with the others.

ui.intro: Six Parts, one method. Open a Part to work on it, or look ahead at what comes next.
